name: Mutual Non-Disclosure Agreement
description: Standard mutual NDA for sharing confidential information between two parties, created by a committee of over 40 attorneys.

name: Mutual NDA Cover Page
description: Cover page template to be completed and signed alongside the Mutual NDA standard terms.

name: Cloud Service Agreement
description: Standard agreement for selling and buying cloud software and SaaS products, covering subscription terms, data handling, and service levels.

name: Design Partner Agreement
description: Standard agreement for early-stage design partnerships, allowing vendors to work closely with design partners to shape their product.

name: Service Level Agreement
description: Standard SLA defining uptime commitments and remedies, designed to be used alongside the Cloud Service Agreement.

name: Professional Services Agreement
description: Standard agreement for professional services engagements, covering SOW terms, deliverables, and payment.

name: Data Processing Agreement
description: Standard DPA for governing the processing of personal data, designed to support compliance with GDPR and other privacy regulations.

name: Partnership Agreement
description: Standard agreement for technology vendor partnerships, covering referral, reseller, and co-sell arrangements.

name: Software License Agreement
description: Standard agreement for licensing software to customers, covering license grants, restrictions, support, and payment terms.

name: Pilot Agreement
description: Standard short-term agreement allowing prospective customers to trial a product or service before committing to a full commercial contract.

name: Business Associate Agreement
description: Standard BAA for HIPAA compliance, governing the handling of protected health information between covered entities and business associates.

name: AI Addendum
description: Standard addendum for AI products and services, covering data use, model training restrictions, and AI-specific risk allocations.
